notes.title: DW II - v0.54
notes.content: [h2][b][i][u]GAME-MODE UPDATES[/u][/i][/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]OVERALL[/b][/p][list][*][p]Testing constant traffic flow - AFK on highway or AI modes will now have cars constantly cycle instead of eventually having them all disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Leader-boards added & tested for all game-modes *NOT multiplayer yet.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed score not saving when dying or resetting.[/p][/*][*][p]Testing new starting locations & camera animations for starting a game-mode.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]LEGACY HIGHWAY[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Road pieces added[/p][/*][*][p]New script to manage all Mountains, objects and buildings and ensure each chunk is based on a random seed that is made on load & sent over RPC - This will ensure it is synced over multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Changes the random object system manager to create more environment variation.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]HIGHWAY & ENDLESS[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a "Mid-Run" tune garage to be able to tune the car mid run. This piece is semi rare compared to other pieces and sometimes might not even spawn.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]MULTIPLAYER[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new maps / setup new servers for testing syncing players with NO AI cars in the room.[/p][/*][*][p]Added other game-modes to test like Endless, Warp-speed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b][i][u]CAR MECHANICS[/u][/i][/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]SLOW-MOTION[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added key-bind options in settings[/p][/*][*][p]Should now make the super jump active. ( lowered the base jump height )[/p][/*][*][p]Working on making it work inside Multiplayer!! Currently works but causes stutters.[/p][/*][*][p]Boosting while in Slo-mo is broken at the moment - creating an infinite boost. But I like this for testing so I am not going to take it out yet.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New tune option ( Boost power! )[/p][/*][*][p]Slight camera chase setting changes & back-end setup to allow for more customization ( Should come in next update. )[/p][/*][*][p]Slight Changes to angular damp settings ( internal controller tweaks )[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b][i][u]OTHER CHANGES[/u][/i][/b][/h2][list][*][p]"PRESS SPACE TO START" Sizing issue fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Main menu to garage animation re-work[/p][list][*][p]Now code based and should not get stuck as well as added improved zoom and movement mechanics.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Slight visual update to garage environment and surrounding.[/p][/*][*][p]Default car tunes changed.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Fixed score not saving when dying or resetting.

tags.feature: Leader-boards added & tested for all game-modes *NOT multiplayer yet.
Testing new starting locations & camera animations for starting a game-mode.
New Road pieces added
New script to manage all Mountains, objects and buildings and ensure each chunk is based on a random seed that is made on load & sent over RPC - This will ensure it is synced over multiplayer
Changes the random object system manager to create more environment variation.
Added a "Mid-Run" tune garage to be able to tune the car mid run. This piece is semi rare compared to other pieces and sometimes might not even spawn.
Added new maps / setup new servers for testing syncing players with NO AI cars in the room.
Added other game-modes to test like Endless, Warp-speed.
Added key-bind options in settings
Should now make the super jump active. ( lowered the base jump height )
Working on making it work inside Multiplayer!! Currently works but causes stutters.
New tune option ( Boost power! )
Slight camera chase setting changes & back-end setup to allow for more customization ( Should come in next update. )

tags.bug: "PRESS SPACE TO START" Sizing issue fixed

tags.feature: Main menu to garage animation re-work
Now code based and should not get stuck as well as added improved zoom and movement mechanics.
Slight visual update to garage environment and surrounding.

notes.title: DW II - v0.53
notes.content: [h2][u][i][b]Physics & Controller Updates[/b][/i][/u][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Physics Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed update tick-rate changed[/p][list][*][p]Dynamic range for performance reasons[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Dynamic collision detection based on vehicle actions[/p][/*][*][p]Changed overall collision detection[/p][/*][*][p]Other small physics update loop value changes[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Controller Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Brake system rework[/p][list][*][p]Added option in tuning menu as well[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed all steering and major inputs to be in the fixed update loop[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked back-end controller base values[/p][/*][*][p]Auto Dampen system when in air[/p][list][*][p]This is tied to angular dampening in the tune menu[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Collision Hit-box type change for all "STREET" cars only. ( Still testing )[/p][/*][*][p]Camera move options for the mouse changed as well as controller support by pressing in on the right D-Pad. ( Key-binds coming soon for those. )[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u][i][b]UI Updates[/b][/i][/u][/h2][list][*][p]MUSIC PANEL[/p][list][*][p]Added music panel ( song title still does not work )[/p][/*][*][p]Added playlist panel for swapping out playlist[/p][/*][*][p]Added Custom playlist tab with file explorer to select the .WAV files you want![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]DISPLAY FPS[/p][list][*][p]Ripped out the setting option for display FPS[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced it with Alt F+10 and alt F+11 to cycle through and toggle[/p][/*][*][p]Added Ram counter ( multiple modes )[/p][/*][*][p]Added Audio Counter ( multiple modes )[/p][/*][*][p]Added System info in bottom right[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed all moveable windows to be persistent & visible while still in game[/p][list][*][p]Can change size or disable while in pause menu[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]More key-bind options added in the settings menu for reset & roll[/p][/*][*][p]Option to Hide In-Game UI in the settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added exact version number in home screen above name[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u][i][b]Garage Updates[/b][/i][/u][/h2][list][*][p]Added zoom slider to get a closer look at the cars ( still WIP )[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Car Price display to show BUY or Sell with the price following.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Brake power tune option to the car ( Normalized from 1-10[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Other small bug-fixes and changed were done here as well as some new custom music added < 3[/p]

tags.feature: - Added option in tuning menu as well
- Auto Dampen system when in air
- Collision Hit-box type change for all "STREET" cars only. ( Still testing )
- Camera move options for the mouse changed as well as controller support by pressing in on the right D-Pad. ( Key-binds coming soon for those. )
- Added music panel ( song title still does not work )
- Added playlist panel for swapping out playlist
- Added Custom playlist tab with file explorer to select the .WAV files you want!
- Replaced it with Alt F+10 and alt F+11 to cycle through and toggle
- Added Ram counter ( multiple modes )
- Added Audio Counter ( multiple modes )
- Added System info in bottom right
- Changed all moveable windows to be persistent & visible while still in game
- Can change size or disable while in pause menu
- More key-bind options added in the settings menu for reset & roll
- Option to Hide In-Game UI in the settings menu.
- Added exact version number in home screen above name
- Added zoom slider to get a closer look at the cars ( still WIP )
- Changed Car Price display to show BUY or Sell with the price following.
- Added Brake power tune option to the car ( Normalized from 1-10
